3  Dictionary

This is a (Kadagidze and Kadagidze 1984) dictionary with some additions from Diana Kakashvili and Jesse Wichers Schreur. It still need some polishing. Download in .csv or .xslx format.

Kadagidze, Davit, and Niko Kadagidze. 1984. C’ova-Tušur-Kartul-Rusul Leksik’oni [Tsova-Tush-Georgian-Russian Dictionary]. Mecniereba.
